author: Nick Carter (mrnicholasbcarter-code); code merged in PR 1053

acceptance.criterion: verdict eligibility --json on the live catalogue drops kilocode/kilo-auto/free, kilocode/kilo-auto/small and kilocode/openrouter/free at DISCOVERED as opaque routes; none of them is TASK_ELIGIBLE

first_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict eligibility --json | jq -c '{evaluated: .evaluated_count, task_eligible: .summary.by_reached_stage.TASK_ELIGIBLE, opaque: [.verdicts[] | select(.route_id == "kilocode/kilo-auto/free" or .route_id == "kilocode/kilo-auto/small" or .route_id == "kilocode/openrouter/free") | {route_id, reached, failed_stage, reason}], opaque_task_eligible: [.verdicts[] | select(.reached == "TASK_ELIGIBLE") | .route_id | select(. == "kilocode/kilo-auto/free" or . == "kilocode/kilo-auto/small" or . == "kilocode/openrouter/free")]}'

fresh_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict eligibility --json | jq -c '{evaluated: .evaluated_count, task_eligible: .summary.by_reached_stage.TASK_ELIGIBLE, opaque: [.verdicts[] | select(.route_id == "kilocode/kilo-auto/free" or .route_id == "kilocode/kilo-auto/small" or .route_id == "kilocode/openrouter/free") | {route_id, reached, failed_stage, reason}], opaque_task_eligible: [.verdicts[] | select(.reached == "TASK_ELIGIBLE") | .route_id | select(. == "kilocode/kilo-auto/free" or . == "kilocode/kilo-auto/small" or . == "kilocode/openrouter/free")]}'

stays_true_job: verdict-acceptance.timer runs `verdict eligibility --json` against the live gateway every hour as its eligibility check

setup_doctor.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict doctor --json | jq -c '{status, issues, warnings, gateway: [.capability_bootstrap.capabilities[] | select(.capability_id | startswith("gateway.")) | {capability_id, status, health}]}'
